title: consciousness is not located
subtitle: the 36 tattvas — how one becomes many without leaving itself
continuity_object: gold ring of Siva surviving every contraction

scenes.title: Siva
scenes.narration: Pure consciousness, the unconditioned ground.

scenes.title: Not a god
scenes.narration: Siva is not a deity — it is the field of all possible appearing.

scenes.title: Sakti
scenes.narration: The power to appear as all this — consciousness is not static.

scenes.title: Dynamic
scenes.narration: Siva-Sakti are not two things — they are the same reality as ground and as power.

scenes.title: Sadasiva
scenes.narration: I-am-this — the first pulse of subject and object together.

scenes.title: First distinction
scenes.narration: Not two — one pulse that contains both poles.

scenes.title: Isvara
scenes.narration: This-ness becomes prominent — the world begins to appear as other.

scenes.title: The object pole
scenes.narration: Objectivity emerges from the unity.

scenes.title: Sadvidya
scenes.narration: I-ness becomes prominent — the sense of self emerges.

scenes.title: The subject pole
scenes.narration: Subjectivity emerges from the unity.

scenes.title: Maya
scenes.narration: Consciousness contracts into finitude — the power of limitation.

scenes.title: Not illusion
scenes.narration: Maya is not false appearance — it is consciousness freely choosing to appear limited.

scenes.title: Kala
scenes.narration: Limited agency — I can only do this much.

scenes.title: Vidya
scenes.narration: Limited knowledge — I can only know this much.

scenes.title: Raga
scenes.narration: Attachment — I want this and not that.

scenes.title: Kala
scenes.narration: Time — I experience sequence, not simultaneity.

scenes.title: Niyati
scenes.narration: Causality — events appear determined.

scenes.title: Purusha
scenes.narration: The individual experiencer enters.

scenes.title: Prakrti
scenes.narration: The apparatus of experience — nature as the field of limitation.

scenes.title: Buddhi
scenes.narration: The intellect — discernment, decision, the capacity to know this as this.

scenes.title: Ahankara
scenes.narration: The I-maker — the sense that this experience belongs to me.

scenes.title: Manas
scenes.narration: The mind — attention, deliberation, oscillation.

scenes.title: The five senses
scenes.narration: Hearing, touching, seeing, tasting, smelling — gates through which consciousness perceives.

scenes.title: The five subtle elements
scenes.narration: Sound, touch, form, taste, smell — the raw data of perception.

scenes.title: The five gross elements
scenes.narration: Ether, air, fire, water, earth — consciousness becomes physical.

scenes.title: Ether
scenes.narration: Space — the first condition of physical appearance.

scenes.title: Earth
scenes.narration: The most contracted form of consciousness.

scenes.title: The body
scenes.narration: Earth tattva — the final density of appearing.

scenes.title: Matter as consciousness
scenes.narration: The body is not unconscious — it is consciousness appearing at maximum contraction.

scenes.title: Neuroscience
scenes.narration: Modern science looks for consciousness inside the brain.

scenes.title: Not found
scenes.narration: After decades of searching, the neural correlate is not the thing itself.

scenes.title: Wrong question
scenes.narration: Abhinavagupta: you cannot find consciousness inside experience because consciousness is the space of experience.

scenes.title: The descent
scenes.narration: 36 tattvas: one consciousness appearing as all this.

scenes.title: The ascent
scenes.narration: The return path: from earth back to Siva — consciousness recognizing itself.

scenes.title: Discipline
scenes.narration: The tattvas are ontological, not physical.

scenes.title: No reduction
scenes.narration: They describe modes of appearing, not physical layers.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: Siva never leaves. The 36 tattvas are the same one, appearing at different densities of self-limitation.

scenes.title: Final frame
scenes.narration: Consciousness is not located. It is where location appears.
